title: Oriental Film Company

page_data.en:
6. 2. M-1-37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.3, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. S. R. D. 8037
Date Aug. 13, 1937.
Subject Oriental Film Company.
Made by X and Forwarded by D.S.I. Laurier.
In accordance with the arrangements reported in this
Section's report of August 11 on the above subject: at 3 p.m.
on August 11 detectives attached to J. 1 and S. 5 Sections,
Headquarters, proceeded to Room 6, House 278 Range Road, with
a view to interviewing Mr. Woldemar Gottlieb regarding certain
films he was alleged to have on hand for sale. Mr. Gottlieb
being absent detectives interviewed a Mr. A.V. Zankin who
stated that he had a selection of films consisting of educational
shorts and features of the jungle type. He appeared to be an
honest man and impressed detectives favourably. When detectives
suggested an interest in films of good drawing value such as
the indecent type of picture he declined to discuss the matter
further.
There is some indication that the operators of the
Oriental Film Company, becoming suspicious of the detectives
sent to interview them thought it expedient to divert their
attentions to another quarter: hence the introduction to
Mr. Zankin.
Mr. Zankin is listed as a Cinema Operator and has no
Police record.
In view of the foregoing, detectives will try other
methods of ascertaining the real character of the Oriental
Film Company and its organizers.
Laurier
D. S. I.
D. C. Special Branch.

6. 2. M-1-37
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.3，特别股。
报告
档案号 S. R. D. 8037
日期 1937年8月13日。
主题 东方影片公司（Oriental Film Company）。
由 X 制作，经特别股督察长劳里尔（Laurier）转呈。
根据本股8月11日关于上述主题的报告中所汇报的安排：8月11日下午3时，总部 J.1 和 S.5 股的侦探前往兰路（Range Road）278号6室，旨在就据称其手头持有待售的某些影片一事，询问沃尔德马·戈特利布（Woldemar Gottlieb）先生。由于戈特利布先生不在，侦探询问了一位 A.V. 赞金（A.V. Zankin）先生，他声称自己拥有一批影片，包括教育类短片和丛林题材的故事片。他看起来是个诚实的人，给侦探留下了良好的印象。当侦探表示对具有良好票房吸引力的影片（如淫秽类影片）感兴趣时，他拒绝进一步讨论此事。
有迹象表明，东方影片公司的经营者对派去询问他们的侦探产生了怀疑，认为将他们的注意力转移到别处是权宜之计：因此才引荐了赞金先生。
赞金先生登记为电影院经营者，无警方记录。
鉴于上述情况，侦探将尝试其他方法以查明东方影片公司及其组织者的真实性质。
劳里尔
特别股副督察长
特别股副总监

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.........F.0.3.7
S. 3, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date......Aug...11...1937.
Subject.........Oriental Film Company (东方影片公司).

Made by... and .......................................Forwarded by............D.S.I. Laurier.

With further reference to this Section's report of
August 9 regarding the Oriental Film Company: further enquiries
reveal that in addition to Joseph Is evich Ionin, the forger,
two other men of questionable character are connected with the
firm. One is Cesar Luiz dos Remedios, Portuguese subject,
born in Shanghai on November 5, 1915, who was sentenced to
four months imprisonment and fined $75.00 or 15 days on
July 15, 1936 for misappropriation. The other is Waldemar
Gottlieb, who, together with one Romuald Dulsky, an associate
of his, was charged with fraud and found not guilty by the
S.S.D. Court on June 12, 1937.

A detective attached to this Section, representing
himself to be a theatre proprietor, has paid several visits
to the Oriental Film Company, Room 427, 128 Museum Road
(telephone 11981) and has ascertained that the firm has been
in existence for two months and is alleged to be engaged in
the distribution of foreign films to the South Sea Islands.
Besides those already mentioned there are an Eurasian typist
and two Chinese clerks, one of whom is named Zee (徐成钱),
in the office.

On 11th instant the detective paid another visit
to the above address when he was interviewed by those already
mentioned above and another foreigner whose name could not be
ascertained, who spoke fluent Chinese. The detective was
very carefully questioned by the latter who seemed to be
suspicious of him. He was eventually told to proceed to
278 Range Road, Room 6 (telephone 43081) this afternoon,
August 11th, and interview Mr. Waldemar Gottlieb, who would
show him some films with a view to an eventual purchase.

（左侧批注及印章）：

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号.........F.0.3.7
S. 3，特别股。
报告
日期......1937年8月11日。
主题.........东方影片公司（东方影片公司）。

由... 制作，并由............特别股督察长劳里尔（Laurier）转呈。

继本股8月9日关于东方影片公司的报告之后：进一步调查显示，除了伪造者约瑟夫·伊谢维奇·伊奥宁（Joseph Is evich Ionin）外，还有两名品行可疑的男子与该公司有关联。其中一人是塞萨尔·路易斯·多斯·雷梅迪奥斯（Cesar Luiz dos Remedios），葡萄牙籍，1915年11月5日出生于上海，因挪用公款罪于1936年7月15日被判处四个月监禁，并处罚金75.00美元或替代刑期15天。另一人是沃尔德马·戈特利布（Waldemar Gottlieb），他与同伙罗穆阿尔德·杜尔斯基（Romuald Dulsky）一起被控欺诈，并于1937年6月12日被上海第二特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）宣判无罪。

本股的一名侦探自称是剧院老板，多次访问位于博物馆路（Museum Road）128号427室的东方影片公司（电话 11981），并查明该公司已成立两个月，据称从事向南海岛屿发行外国影片的业务。除了前面提到的人之外，办公室里还有一名欧亚混血打字员和两名中国职员，其中一人名为徐成钱（Zee）。

本月11日，侦探再次访问上述地址，接待他的是前述人员以及另一名身份不明的外国人，此人能说流利的中文。后者非常仔细地盘问了侦探，似乎对他起了疑心。最后，他被要求于今天下午，即8月11日，前往兰路（Range Road）278号6室（电话 43081），会见沃尔德马·戈特利布先生，后者将向他展示一些影片，以便最终购买。

（左侧批注及印章）：
DC (-)
阅
（印：1937年8月22日 * 上海）
（印：1937年8月13日 (刑事侦缉...)）
已监视

S.3, Special Branch.
REPORT

File No....................
REGISTRY
8037
Date...Aug...9..10/9 37. 13/7

Subject...Oriental Film Company.

Made by...C.A. Cook....................Forwarded by....................

Mr. J.J. Kohler, secretary of the Film Board of Trade
(China), 142 Museum Road, has informed me this morning that
the person who is at the head of the Oriental Film Company,
Room 427, 123 Museum Road, is a Russian named Ionin who was
arrested some two years ago in connection with swindling the
Chartered Bank of India, Australia & China.
Mr. Kohler states that the Chinese in the employ of
Ionin do not know what this man is doing and have no knowledge
of any film transactions.

日期...1937年8月9日..10/9 37. 13/7

主题...东方影片公司。

由...C.A. 库克（C.A. Cook）制作....................由....................转呈。

中国电影贸易委员会（Film Board of Trade (China)）秘书 J.J. 科勒（J.J. Kohler）先生（地址：博物馆路142号）今晨告知我，东方影片公司（地址：博物馆路123号427室）的负责人是一名名叫伊奥宁（Ionin）的俄国人，他大约在两年前因涉及诈骗印度新金山中国汇理银行（Chartered Bank of India, Australia & China）而被捕。
科勒先生称，受雇于伊奥宁的中国人不知道此人在做什么，也不了解任何影片交易。
